theorem running_actual (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    (running c hc T : GaussianTimeProductL2.TimeProbabilityL2)
      =ᵐ[GaussianTimeProductL2.timeProbability]
      (PredictableRealL2.horizon T).indicator (fun z =>
        -c * BrownianSignIntegral.signum (BrownianClockWeightedEnergy.sigma z) *
          Real.exp (-c * |BrownianClockWeightedEnergy.sigma z|))

theorem actual_ito (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    (fun Y => Real.exp (-c * |IBMConstructedSources.clockPath Y T|) - 1)
      =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] fun Y => itoIntegral (running c hc T) Y -
        c * BrownianMassContinuousLimit.limitPath Y T +
        (c ^ 2 / 2) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(T : ℝ),
          Real.exp (-c * |IBMConstructedSources.clockPath Y s.toNNReal|)

human_reorganization: One-time auxiliary-product scaling and the global second/fourth/eighth moments, with actual integrability, are explicit human Gaussian-mixture consequences. No process-level coupling or unconditional two-time identification inferred.
Completed-square Gaussian-tail expression and elementary transform upper bound are direct human integral calculations, not mapped special-function declarations.

Integrated endpoint Fourier ODE and compact-frequency spatial PDE are proved by ordinary finite-frequency Fubini and dominated differentiation. No general C0/PDE uniqueness, fractional generator, density regularity or Markov-domain claim.

The exact initial cusp is the scalar consequence of the mapped parameter derivative; the direct second-moment convolution witness is labelled human. Non-convolution composition does not exclude an arbitrary nontranslation Markov model.

The local-time prerequisite is the existing constructed Tanaka/supported-mass theorem exposed in the sticky-clock companion. Its corollary is reconstructed here via a genuine global C2 extension. Full import-proof review is not claimed.
